description: A valid motion spec declares a standard easing, unique animation IDs, symmetric enter/exit types, and layout/move transitions for dynamic content.

rules.description: A named standard, default, or base easing must exist. Without a canonical fallback, components that don't declare a specific easing have no safe default.
Every animation must have a unique id. Duplicate IDs make animations unreferable by downstream component compilers.
At least one animation with type move, layout, reorder, or transition must exist. Dynamic UI (sorted lists, tab panels, accordion) requires layout animations.
